notation_and_corrections: W_i^Q denotes the learned query projection; Q_i = E W_i^Q denotes the projected queries.
S_i denotes masked scores and A_i denotes normalized attention weights. Future scores are negative infinity; future weights are zero.
The score pictures display Q_i K_i^T + M (or its absorbed latent equivalent) before dividing by sqrt(128). M has only zero and negative infinity, so this agrees with masking after scaling.
Tokens are rows except in the explicitly labelled column-convention figure; its mask and softmax axis are transposed.
Packed head score sums are valid block identities but are not a replacement for separate head softmax.
MLA content absorption preserves the original score scale sqrt(d_h), even when the absorbed coordinate width is r.
The algebraic absorption and identity-cache proposal omit biases and positional transformations; full MLA's positional branch is a separately sourced addition.
The 96-head projection example and the 128-head, 61-layer cache example are separate illustrative settings.
The cache estimates assume two bytes per scalar. One additional token adds about four MB across the example's layers; about 400 GB is the total for 100,000 tokens.
The full-MLA 64-coordinate positional key, rank explanations, explicit index proofs, and masking expansions are checked explanatory additions.

verification.rendering: All detailed PNG previews were visually inspected; SVG mathematical glyphs are vector paths. The generator also checks every text bounding box against its canvas.
